1.text: “Nasezeranye n'amaso yanjye,None se nabasha nte kwifuza umukobwa?

2.text: “Icyo Imana itanga kivuye mu ijuru ni iki?Kandi Ishoborabyose itanga murage ki uva hejuru mu ijuru?

3.text: Mbese kurimbuka si ko kugenerwa umunyabyaha,Ibyago bigategekerwa inkozi z'ibibi?

4.text: Imana ntiyitegereza inzira zanjye,Ikabara intambwe zanjye zose?

5.text: “Niba naragendeye mu binyoma,Ikirenge cyanjye kikihutira kuriganya,

6.text: Henga mpimirwe ku minzani ireshya,Kugira ngo Imana imenye gutungana kwanjye.

7.text: Niba intambwe zanjye zarateshutse inzira,Umutima wanjye ukayobezwa n'ibyo amaso yanjye areba,Kandi niba inenge yarometse ku biganza byanjye,

8.text: Ndakabiba hasarure undi,Ni ukuri imyaka yo mu murima wanjye irakarandurwa.

9.text: “Niba umutima wanjye warashutswe n'umugore,Nkubikirira ku muryango w'umuturanyi wanjye,

10.text: Umugore wanjye aragasera undi,Kandi ashakwe n'abandi.

11.text: Kuko icyo cyaba ari ikibi gikabijeNi ukuri ni ikizira cyo guhanwa n'abacamanza,

12.text: Kuko cyamera nk'umuriro ukongora ukageza ku kurimbuka,Kandi cyarandura ibyo nungutse byose.

13.text: “Niba narahinyuye urubanza rw'umugaragu wanjye,Cyangwa urw'umuja wanjye igihe bamburanyaga,

14.text: None se ubwo Imana ihagurutse nabigenza nte?Mbese yangenderera nayibwira iki?

15.text: Cyo ye, iyandemye mu nda ya mama si yo yamuremye?Iyaturemye mu nda za ba mama si imwe?

16.text: “Hari ubwo nimye abakene ibyo bifuza,Cyangwa se ngahebya amaso y'umupfakazi,

18.text: Ahubwo uhereye mu busore bwanjye,Yankuriye iruhande ndi nka se,N'umupfakazi namuhagarikiye nkiva mu nda ya mama.

19.text: “Niba hari uwo nabonye wishwe no kubura umwambaro,Cyangwa indushyi ibuze icyo kwiyorosa,

20.text: Niba urukenyerero rwe rutampaye umugisha,Kandi ntasusurutswe n'ubwoya bw'intama zanjye,

21.text: Niba narabanguriye impfubyi ukuboko,Kuko mfite umfasha ku irembo,

22.text: Noneho urutugu rwanjye ruragatandukana n'umubiri,N'ukuboko kwanjye kuvunike gutane n'igufwa.

23.text: Kuko ibyago biva ku Mana byanteraga ubwoba,Simbone uko mbasha kwihanganira gukomera kwayo.

24.text: “Niba naragize izahabu ho ibyiringiro byanjye,Nkabwira izahabu nziza nti ‘Ni wowe nishingikirijeho’,

25.text: Niba narishimishijwe n'uko ubutunzi bwanjye ari bwinshi,Ukuboko kwanjye kukaronka byinshi,

26.text: Niba naritegereje izuba igihe riva,Cyangwa ukwezi kugenda kurabagirana nkabiramya,

27.text: Kandi umutima wanjye ugashukashukwa rwihishwa,N'ikiganza cyanjye nkakinyweraho isubyo,

28.text: Ibyo na byo byambera ibibi biragahanwa n'abacamanza,Kuko ari uguhemukira Imana iri hejuru.

29.text: “Hari ubwo nishimiye kurimbuka k'unyanga,Cyangwa nkishyirishwa hejuru n'uko ibyago bimugezeho?

30.text: Ahubwo sinakundiye akanwa kanjye gucumura,Ngo mwifurize gupfa muvumye?

31.text: Hari ubwo ab'iwanjye batahamije bati‘Hari umuntu wabona n'umwe wavuga yuko adahagira mu rugo rwe’?

32.text: Nta mushyitsi naraje hanzeAhubwo umugenzi wese naramwugururiraga.

33.text: Hari ubwo natwikiriye ibicumuro byanjye nka Adamu,Ngahisha ibyaha byanjye mu gituza,

34.text: Mbitewe no gutinya iteraniro rinini,Ngaterwa ubwoba no kugawa n'indi miryango,Bituma nceceka sinsohoke?

35.text: “Iyaba hari unyumvise!Dore ngiki icyitegererezo cyanjye,Ishoborabyose ninsubize,Nanjye mbone ibirego byanditswe n'umwanzi wanjye.

36.text: Ni koko nabiheka ku rutugu,Nabyitamirizaho nk'ikamba.

38.text: “Niba imisozi yanjye ihururiye kundega,N'amayogi yo muri yo akaririra hamwe,

39.text: Niba narariye umwero wayo nta feza ntanze,Cyangwa niba naratumye bene yo baheba ubugingo bwabo,

40.text: Noneho ibisura birakamera ah'ingano,N'urukungu rumere aha sayiri.”Iyo ni yo ndunduro y'amagambo ya Yobu.
